_note: Activepieces 0.93.0. Seed first with three no-auth demo flows (Lead intake: score and store; Daily exchange-rate digest; Shop order webhook) and a few runs: scripts/seed-activepieces-demo.py <vars.json> <url> (flows imported via POST /api/v1/flows/:id IMPORT_FLOW, then LOCK_AND_PUBLISH, then webhook calls). Sign in through the form as ${ADMIN_EMAIL} / ${ADMIN_PASSWORD}. Theme: localStorage 'vite-ui-theme' = light | dark before load. The builder and run shots open the 'Score the lead' Code step by clicking its card (click by coordinates: the canvas intercepts locator clicks).

pages.path: /projects/<project id>/runs/<a succeeded lead intake run id>
